title: MedPAO-Assist：可边缘部署、模态感知的放射报告结构化智能体AI
summary: 提出MedPAO-Assist，一个可在边缘设备部署的多智能体框架，基于0.6B参数小模型，通过提取-对齐-生成范式，从放射科医生口述和语音指令直接生成结构化报告，仅需约3.3GB内存，笔记本CPU上端到端延迟约31秒，支持四种影像模态，全程无需键盘、外部API或联网。
summary_en: MedPAO-Assist is an edge-deployable multi-agent framework using a 0.6B-parameter small language model to generate structured radiology reports from dictation and voice commands via an Extract-Ground-Generate paradigm. It needs only ~3.3 GB RAM and ~31s end-to-end latency on a laptop CPU, supports four imaging modalities, and requires no keyboard, external API, or internet.
